diagnosis: The checks C1 and C3 passed because the lone decision-maker used the exact ejection fraction of 32 percent (PF1), which was accessible to all agents as a public fact. This allowed the decision-maker to correctly enroll the patient in the program and specify the appropriate monitoring bundle and connection method, even though PF1 was not intended to be used by a single agent.

C1.why: The exact ejection fraction of 32 percent establishes eligibility, changes the recorded clinical value to 32, and supplies the clinical recommendation for a connected scale and blood-pressure monitoring.

fix_instructions: Tighten checks C1 and C3 to require the involvement of multiple agents. Specifically, modify flips 'C1' and 'C3' to depend on a new collective fact 'CF1', which can only be flipped if at least two agents agree on the ejection fraction. This ensures that the exact ejection fraction cannot be used by a single agent to make critical decisions.
